title: Design panel
responsibility: Displays a selected design version and option, or a function’s written plan, and connects image annotations to conversation callbacks.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.entity
inputs.description: The entity whose design versions, options, images, notes and threads the panel shows; only threads on the shown version and image are passed to the annotated image, and only those with a region get a pin. A function entity shows its plan notes and never an image, and a page entity also shows its size and performance text.

examples.summary: Chooses the design option a version shows: the one asked for when the version holds it, else the approved option, else the first.

versions.notes: Choose the design option of a version: the wanted one when the version holds it, else the approved option, else the first.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace whose bridge and shown commit read the images, and whose planning capability chooses the guidance shown for an entity without a version. Only a pinned view passes a commit to the prior-image selection, so a before image can appear only in a pinned view.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.annotatable
inputs.description: Whether the shown image and its regions may start a conversation; it is passed to the annotated image as its writable flag, which disables region drawing and the image's comment buttons. When false, the annotation callback is never called, but existing thread pins stay selectable.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.version
inputs.description: Bindable identifier of the design version shown, empty by default and updated when a user selects another version. A value that no version of the entity has, including the empty default, is replaced with the last version's identifier, or with an empty string when the entity has no versions.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.option
inputs.description: Bindable identifier of the design option shown, empty by default; the panel never chooses one on its own, so a version with options shows no image until the parent binds an option that the version holds. A version without options ignores this value, and choosing an option in the panel writes its identifier back here.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.onthread
inputs.description: Required callback that receives the thread record of a region pin clicked on the shown image, so the parent can open its conversation. Only threads of the shown version and image that have a region get a pin, and an error thrown by this callback is not caught by the panel.

inputs.name: DesignPanel.onannotate
inputs.description: Required asynchronous callback for a comment on the loaded image, given a target with its version, image hash, state, viewport, option (when the image has one) and region, or a null region for the whole image. It is called only while annotatable is true, and a rejection is caught and shown as the panel's error text.

outputs.name: DesignPanel
outputs.description: Markup of the panel: a heading, the version and option selectors, the viewport and image-state selectors (which fall back to the images that exist), and the annotated image with a prior image when one applies. Without a displayable image it shows the version's planned behavior notes, or planning or no-design guidance when no version exists; a function's notes are marked as proposed, and a page also shows a size and performance row.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: An error thrown by the onthread callback propagates out of the panel when a region pin is selected, because the panel does not catch it. Failures from onannotate and from reading an image are caught and shown as the panel's error text instead.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.
